CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_administrator()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid()
      AND (
        role = 'administrator'
        OR 'administrator' = ANY(coalesce(roles, ARRAY[]::text[]))
      )
  );
$function$
